Item Class: Augment
Rarity: Currency
Soul Core of Tacati
--------
Stack Size: 1/10
--------
Requires: Level 65
--------
Martial Weapons: 15% chance to Poison on Hit with this weapon
Armour: +11% to Chaos Resistance
--------
Place into an empty Augment Socket in a Martial Weapon or Armour to apply its effect to that item. Once Socketed it cannot be retrieved without destroying it.
Shift click to unstack.
